d:
Welcome to our channel! Sit back, relax, and immerse yourself in the enchanting world of music as we present our heartfelt unplugged cover of the timeless classic "Kya Hua Tera Vada."
In this soulful rendition, Pranav Chandran takes you on a nostalgic journey, capturing the essence of the original song while adding their own unique touch. Stripped down to its acoustic core, this rendition breathes new life into the melody, creating an intimate and emotionally evocative experience.
Cover Song Credits:
Singer: Pranav Chandran
Music Produced: Pranshu Jha
Video: RJ Productions
